snippet.title: Villainy - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the official reveal trailer for Villainy, a fast-paced, high-stakes game of social deduction developed by Studio Rend. In this game of cooperation and betrayal, gather your party, but trust no one. Deception is your greatest weapon, and secrecy is the ultimate defense. Villainy is coming soon to PC (Steam).
